diagnosis: The Jinja2 view renders confidential W-2 tax information (Social Security Numbers, federal withholding, annual taxable wages) looked up solely by form_id. It fails to check tax_form.employee_id == user.employee_id, allowing any authenticated employee to view sensitive wage and identity details of other employees.
exploit_request:
GET /payroll/forms/tax_2025_9982/view HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.example.com
Cookie: session_token=employee_user_session
